text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You should use that. It's perfect for 
taking a little rest.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
No! Rather than me, Trainer Kashimoto 
should use it! It'll be a nice change of 
pace!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
That won't be necessary. Besides, for a 
Trainer to receive something like this 
from their trainee――

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Oh, perfect timing! Don't say a word, just 
take this!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait right there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Bitter Glasse had thrust upon me was 
a discount coupon for a ranch.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
She said she received it when she went 
shopping. I told her I didn't need it, 
but...
choice_data_list: Since we have the chance, why don't we go?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Just... you and me?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Well, now that I've accepted it, I 
can't let it go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...It's lovely. There is very little to 
obstruct the view, and the air is so crisp 
and clear.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
The grounds are spacious, so just walking 
around ought to make for some good 
training.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. If she were here, she could 
have gotten some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
For my sake... going out of your way with 
unneeded distractions...
choice_data_list: Did they look tired to you?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, then it is my 
oversight.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...True, it has been quite busy lately.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Bitter Glasse may not seem like it, but 
she can be sharp in the strangest ways.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
To ensure this never happens again, I must 
build more stamina myself――

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Um. Is that why you invited me as well?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Then let us leave it at that.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Shall we walk? Walking with purpose 
makes for great exercise, after all.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
W-What a peculiar creature. It's staring 
right at us...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Are you mocking me? Of course I know what 
it is. If I recall correctly... it's an 
alcapa, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: A-Ahem. ...My tongue slipped, is all.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Is it really safe to pet a cow...?! What 
if it bites...?!
choice_data_list: Why don't you try petting it too?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes, you're right. I do want to show 
my gratitude for everything.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
The precious milk from these cows provides 
essential nutrition for Umamusume as 
wellâ

text_block_list.name: Cow
text_block_list.text: Moooorning~

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Eep……!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Interacting with the animals, the two of 
us took our time strolling through the 
ranch.
